srList.sentence: We used SEER stat (version 8.3.5) to download data from the SEER 18 registries research database, which contains data from the SEER 13 registries (Atlanta, Connecticut, Detroit, Hawaii, Iowa, New Mexico, San Francisco-Oakland, Seattle-Puget Sound, Utah, Los Angeles, San Jose-Monterey, rural Georgia, and the Alaska Native Tumor Registry) and the registries of greater California, Kentucky, Louisiana, New Jersey, and greater Georgia.

srList.sentence: We identified 309,599 women who were diagnosed with their first stage I-III breast cancer between January 1, 2010 and December 31, 2015 who had cancer histology likely to be treated by standard guidelines and who were not diagnosed at autopsy or death.
